comment:
* A container for multiple * {@link Preference} objects. It is a base class for Preference objects that are * parents, such as {@link PreferenceCategory} and {@link PreferenceScreen}. * *
*

Developer Guides

*

For information about building a settings UI with Preferences, * read the Settings * guide.

*
* * @attr name android:orderingFromXml

variables.name: mPreferenceList
variables.comment:
* The container for child {@link Preference}s. This is sorted based on the
     * ordering, please use {@link #addPreference(Preference)} instead of adding
     * to this directly.

methods.name: public void setOrderingAsAdded(boolean orderingAsAdded)
methods.comment:
* Whether to order the {@link Preference} children of this group as they * are added. If this is false, the ordering will follow each Preference * order and default to alphabetic for those without an order. *

* If this is called after preferences are added, they will not be * re-ordered in the order they were added, hence call this method early on. * * @param orderingAsAdded Whether to order according to the order added. * @see Preference#setOrder(int)

methods.name: public boolean isOrderingAsAdded()
methods.comment:
* Whether this group is ordering preferences in the order they are added.
     *
     * @return Whether this group orders based on the order the children are added.
     * @see #setOrderingAsAdded(boolean)

methods.name: public void addItemFromInflater(Preference preference)
methods.comment: * Called by the inflater to add an item to this group.

methods.name: public int getPreferenceCount()
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of children {@link Preference}s.
     * @return The number of preference children in this group.

methods.name: public Preference getPreference(int index)
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link Preference} at a particular index.
     *
     * @param index The index of the {@link Preference} to retrieve.
     * @return The {@link Preference}.

methods.name: public boolean addPreference(Preference preference)
methods.comment:
* Adds a {@link Preference} at the correct position based on the
     * preference's order.
     *
     * @param preference The preference to add.
     * @return Whether the preference is now in this group.

methods.name: public boolean removePreference(Preference preference)
methods.comment:
* Removes a {@link Preference} from this group.
     *
     * @param preference The preference to remove.
     * @return Whether the preference was found and removed.

methods.name: public void removeAll()
methods.comment: * Removes all {@link Preference Preferences} from this group.

methods.name: protected boolean onPrepareAddPreference(Preference preference)
methods.comment:
* Prepares a {@link Preference} to be added to the group.
     *
     * @param preference The preference to add.
     * @return Whether to allow adding the preference (true), or not (false).

methods.name: public Preference findPreference(CharSequence key)
methods.comment:
* Finds a {@link Preference} based on its key. If two {@link Preference} * share the same key (not recommended), the first to appear will be * returned (to retrieve the other preference with the same key, call this * method on the first preference). If this preference has the key, it will * not be returned. *

* This will recursively search for the preference into children that are * also {@link PreferenceGroup PreferenceGroups}. * * @param key The key of the preference to retrieve. * @return The {@link Preference} with the key, or null.

methods.name: protected boolean isOnSameScreenAsChildren()
methods.comment:
* Whether this preference group should be shown on the same screen as its
     * contained preferences.
     *
     * @return True if the contained preferences should be shown on the same
     *         screen as this preference.

methods.name: public boolean isAttached()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if we're between {@link #onAttached()} and {@link #onPrepareForRemoval()}
     * @hide
